premises.text: The construction industry is wasteful and inefficient due to outdated tools and processes
premises.evidence_span: this global $17 trillion industry is one of the world's most wasteful and inefficient

premises.text: Construction projects often suffer from measurement and tracking issues
premises.evidence_span: they just don't have the technology to measure and keep track of what they're trying to build

premises.text: Robotics and artificial intelligence can improve measurement and tracking in construction
premises.evidence_span: With robotics and artificial intelligence, we are building tools that can help you accurately measure and keep track of construction

premises.text: Automated software can flag construction issues quickly to prevent costly delays
premises.evidence_span: that beam I told you about in Oslo automatically flagged up by software developed by Scaled Robotics within 24 hours

premises.text: Detailed 3D mapping of construction sites can provide valuable data for project management
premises.evidence_span: our robots drive around site, building detailed 3D maps of the environment

premises.text: Data analysis can simplify complex construction information for stakeholders
premises.evidence_span: this complex information is then simplified and delivered back to the client on an easy-to-use web-based interface

premises.text: Construction data can be filtered and searched to identify risks effectively
The software integrates with existing workflows and industry-standard file formats
premises.evidence_span: we seamlessly integrate with existing workflows, including existing laser scanners

value.text: Construction projects can stay on budget and on schedule with improved measurement and tracking
value.evidence_span: our software will help you stay on budget and on schedule on your next project

notes: Examples of outdated tools and processes illustrate P1; they are not separate premises.
